purpose: Teach: びん/左足/トホホ/デブ/キュート/フレンドリー/カミさん/姑

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ジュースのびん割っちゃったろ
lines.en: Riku, you totally broke that juice bottle, didn't you.
lines.style: Quick, knowing jab delivered with a half-smirk. Casual accusation — testing his reaction. Pace stays light, almost playful underneath the call-out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、左足ねん挫したろ?桜
lines.en: You sprained your left ankle, Sakura.
lines.style: Fires back immediately, calm and pointed. Slight lift on the counter-accusation. Not defensive — just matching her energy with his own ammunition.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト結果見て「トホホ」って言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, I heard you actually said 'toho-ho' when you saw your test scores.
lines.style: Gotcha energy. Lighter jab this time, almost conspiratorial — like she's enjoying how caught he is. Slight laugh caught in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、最近デブになったって言われたろ、桜
lines.en: Someone told me you got called fat recently, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady counter. Not mean — just matter-of-fact, matching her pace. Slight pause before her name, letting it land without drama.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新しい服キュートに着こなしてるな
lines.en: Riku, you're actually pulling off those new clothes pretty well.
lines.style: Genuine shift underneath the sarcasm. Softer opening, slower pace. The compliment lands because it's unexpected — surprise in her own voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、転校生にフレンドリーに接してたな、桜
lines.en: You've been really friendly with that transfer student, Sakura.
lines.style: Observation delivered gently. Not accusatory — just noticing something true about her. Slight warmth creeping into the tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父さん、お母さんを「カミさん」って呼ぶよな
lines.en: Riku, your dad actually calls your mom 'Kami-san,' doesn't he.
lines.style: Curious, wondering aloud. Slight laugh at the oddness of it. Not mocking — genuinely intrigued by how affectionate he is.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、姑さんと仲良いって聞いたぞ、桜
lines.en: I heard your dad gets along really well with your mom's mother, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle, observant questioning. Slower pace — genuinely interested in this detail. Warmth underneath, noticing something sweet about his family.
